title: MZ Animated Front View Enemies in RPG Maker MZ ?

posts.author: RustyNoodles
posts.body:
Howdy! I'm working on a project that's primarily in front view. I want to make the enemies you can encounter have animations instead of being just images.
The problem is, I can't find any plug-ins that work with what I want, which is:
Idle
Attack
Hurt
Dead
Status effects (this is optional really)
Is there a plugin (or just a regular way) that works with what I want? I was using one made by xyscripts but it wasn't compatible fully with mz.
Thanks for reading!
- Rusty

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
Hello and welcome! We have a template that you can follow when making support requests, it has READ in all caps with three exclamation mark so it's hard to miss. It will prevent us from having to ask the same questions over and over again, like "do you use any plugins?", "could you show a mock-up/screenshot?", "what tutorials have you followed?" and the like.
READ!!! RPG Maker MZ Support Template
This template will give an idea of what basic support information can help others quickly answer a request.   The more information you provide in the original post, the sooner it can get solved.   A Topical and Meaningful Thread Title  Titles such as “help me” and “it’s broken” are not...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
With that out of the way... the general approach to "animated front-view enemies" is to just pick any "animated sideview enemies" plugin (I personally use
Visustella Battle Core
), and change the home positions so that it "behaves" as front view. All the motions that you want, namely idle, attack, hurt, dead will be available just as they are in sideview.
